chapter: Sharpening the Axe Won't Hinder the Work
act_title: Sharpening the Axe Won't Hinder the Work

quests.title: Sharpening the Axe Won't Hinder the Work

dialogue.sit: I want to find a weapon for Paimon.

dialogue.t: Over there. Take your pick. Or, if you need something else I can make it on request.
Of course. I sell weapons, make them to order, and do refinements. All in the job description for a blacksmith.
All you need is the ore.

dialogue.sit: Where can I get ore from?

dialogue.t: You look confused. Listen, I'll tell you where the nearest deposits are.
Bring some back and I'll help you forge what you need.
No need. I have other things to do.

dialogue.sit: Remember, you sent me to get Iron Chunks...

dialogue.t: Oh. Yes. I'd forgotten about that.
These are okay I guess. Should be able to salvage something from them.
If you ever find ore in the future, you can always come and see me.

dialogue.sit: You seem to be in a bad mood.

dialogue.t: A blacksmith's work takes focus and concentration. It does not take small talk with customers.
When the craft is good, business is good. That's all there is to this trade, and anyone who tells you different is trying to con you.
If there's nothing else, I'll carry on with my work.

quests.description: Paimon believes in order to meet the adventures that are to come, it would be best to first make some preparations.
